# Research agent tools

The `research` agent (`research_agent`) publishes 1 tool to the [Tool Registry](../TOOL_REGISTRY.md). This page is generated from the agent's code: names, descriptions and parameters come from the tool definitions, action classes from `audit.ToolClassification`, and capabilities and eligibility from the agent card options. Capability names are defined in the [capability vocabulary](capabilities.md).

`google_search` is available only when the agent runs on a Gemini model. With any other model the research agent publishes no tools and answers from the model alone.

| Tool | Action class | Capabilities |
|---|---|---|
| [`google_search`](#google_search) | read | `web_search` |

## `google_search`

Performs a Google search to retrieve information from the web.

- **Action class:** read
- **Capabilities:** `web_search`
- **Fleet eligible:** no
- **Auto-remediation eligible:** no
- **See also:**
  - [API.md › `POST /api/v1/research`](../API.md#post-apiv1research)

No parameters.
